preflight_report.fixture_source: canonical scene_room_baseline.usda footprints; room shell is fixed
preflight_report.report_semantics: This stored summary mirrors the executable conservative 2D/grid audit. It is not a live USD collision or physics acceptance record.

usd_authoring_smoke.semantics: Confirms that every existing cluster root and /World/Robot can be authored in a disposable root layer that sublayers the canonical baseline read-only; this is not collision or physics validation.

recipe_policy: Every row is an explicit human-reviewed whole-room recipe. There is no procedural layout generator or Cartesian expansion. The mature Task-7.2 coffee-table operation zone is fixed; only the sofa, side-table, and media zones vary.
scene_policy: one canonical House baseline plus one disposable per-render coordinate overlay
selection_basis: Fifty explicit living-room arrangements with at least 0.10 m inter-cluster fixture clearance. All passed conservative planar geometry, grid navigation, USD author/save/reopen, and the isolated fixed-action Task-7.2 manipulation canary.
validation_scope: candidate planar separation, floor containment, station reachability, 0.05 m grid connectivity, USD author/save/reopen, and Task-7.2 fixed-core/fixed-distractor live manipulation
